entities.name: Uu Message Transfer Sidelink
entities.description: Procedure to transfer Paging message and System Information from the L2 U2N Relay UE to the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE.

entities.name: UuMessageTransferSidelink
entities.description: Message sent from Relay UE to Remote UE containing Paging message and System Information.

entities.name: Paging message
entities.description: Paging information transferred from Relay UE to Remote UE.

entities.name: System Information
entities.description: System Information transferred from Relay UE to Remote UE.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state of the Remote UE during Uu message transfer.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state of the Remote UE during Uu message transfer.

entities.name: L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Relay UE that transfers Paging message and System Information to Remote UE.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE
entities.description: Remote UE that receives Paging message and System Information from Relay UE.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the UuMessageTransferSidelink message.
The message contains Paging message information element.
The message contains System Information information element.
The procedure is performed when Remote UE is in RRC_IDLE state.
The procedure is performed when Remote UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Relay UE sends the UuMessageTransferSidelink message.
Remote UE receives the UuMessageTransferSidelink message.
